recorded_at: actual ISO 8601 recording time with offset
recorded_by: registered recorder id; same id for own contribution
title: Specific change or decision
status: request | proposed | adopted | implemented | measured | failure | not_established | in_progress | explanatory | review | model_output | corrected | superseded
summary: What changed; what the participant actually said or did.
decision_rationale: Concise public decision rationale, relevant alternatives and evidence; not private scratch reasoning.
evidence: repository-relative evidence file, exact Git revision, PR/run URL or documented conversation reference
limitations: What was not measured or not established.
